spellbook.finance/limitations: The seller must sign in to SpellBook Finance on that page. The eBay consent URL signs the SpellBook account that receives the eBay connection, so it is minted only for the seller's own signed-in session and never returned to an agent.
Only the seller presses Connect eBay and approves the eBay consent page. After they finish, verify the result with spellbook_ebay_connection_status instead of opening a SpellBook page.
The link carries no expiry. It opens the page, and the page mints a fresh eBay consent URL when the seller presses Connect eBay.
ManaPool uses spellbook_manapool_connect_link because its seller API uses a key the seller pastes into SpellBook themselves. CardTrader still connects on the account settings page.
TCGplayer has no connect link. Its sync runs through a paired browser extension. Call spellbook_tcg_extension_pairing for the pairing state and the page the seller pairs on.

description: Get the SpellBook Finance page where the seller connects their eBay account. Call spellbook_ebay_connection_status first. Hand the seller only this one link and tell them to sign in to SpellBook Finance, press Connect eBay, then sign in at eBay and approve the connection. Once they finish, call spellbook_ebay_connection_status again. The agent never receives the eBay consent URL, a password, or a token.
name: spellbook_ebay_connect_link
